description: This file defines the SenderRecipient class responsible for managing email recipient data within the Goteo mailing system. It includes properties for recipient details, methods for validation, saving to database, sending emails, and managing lock and sent status.

classes.name: SenderRecipient
classes.description: Handles email recipient data, validation, sending, and status management within the Goteo mailing system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new SenderRecipient instance, setting status based on the 'sent' property.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to check if the recipient is blacklisted.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates recipient email, mailing ID, and blocked status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the recipient data to the database after validation.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Prepares and sends the email to the recipient, updating status accordingly.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Checks if the recipient is blocked.

methods.name: setLock
methods.description: Locks or unlocks the recipient from receiving emails.

methods.name: isSent
methods.description: Checks if the email has been sent to the recipient.

methods.name: setSent
methods.description: Marks the email as sent or unsent.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a SenderRecipient record by ID.

methods.name: getFromMailing
methods.description: Retrieves a sender recipient record matching mailing ID and email.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recipients for a specific mailing, filtered by status.
